hood up, head turned slightly toward camera

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft overcast daylight at approximately 6500K with pale ambient fill

technical_specs.render_style: 50mm lens at f/2.8, subject focus with controlled slow-shutter crowd blur, subtle analog grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fashion editorial portrait of an adult man standing still in the center of a bright, clean, slightly abstract winter city setting. He has loose curly light-brown hair, wears a brown hooded technical jacket with the hood raised, and turns his head slightly toward the camera with a calm stoic expression. Surround him with anonymous people passing by in strong motion blur, while his face and clothing remain sharply focused. Emphasize the visual contrast between static presence and moving silhouettes. Use film composition, art-photography sensibility, soft magazine texture, overcast daylight, a 50mm lens at f/2.8, controlled slow-shutter blur, and portrait 4:5 framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
